items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: if they were going to go anyplace together, somebody had to be along to make it look respectable. So I was elected for that.

ctx.x: Well, of course, I've written that for a book. Okay. But Tallulah was just crazy about Sidney and used to chase him around all the time from city to city.
What was his attitude towards Shaker, though?
